tool_args.rationale: The bridge-supply and flux-conservation signatures, plus the verified two-layer siphon note, favor a coupled temporal mechanism. The five observations vary only u_now at one fixed horizon and cannot identify its dynamic parameters; the open-branch probe is the most targeted next measurement.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary nonlinear snapshot law from the five rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All rows hold u_past, x_now, mem_conv, s_grad, and H fixed, so they do not identify the stated two-layer temporal bridge dynamics.
More samples on the same trajectory are less useful than a probe that distinguishes the open-branch mechanism.
It is explicitly nuisance data and not needed to resolve the mechanism.
